payload.explanation:
Journal entry JE-005 is quarantined because account 6315 is not in the chart of accounts, preventing the entry from being reported.
- Account 6315 on line 1 is not in the chart of accounts, so the entry cannot be reported until the account is set up or the line is corrected.
- The closest existing accounts to 6315 are 6310 Travel and Entertainment, 8200 Deferred Tax Expense, and 2160 Deferred Revenue. Remapping 6315 to 6310 Travel and Entertainment would cancel the entry because that account is already on the other side.
Next step: To resolve this, either add account 6315 to the chart of accounts or correct the account code on line 1 of journal entry JE-005.
